title: Invisible Saboteurs: Sycophantic LLMs Mislead Novices in Problem-Solving Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Within-subjects experiment comparing interactions with high-sycophancy and low-sycophancy chatbots during an open-ended machine learning debugging task to evaluate impacts on user mental models, workflows, and task performance.
Administering pre- and post-task knowledge quizzes (mental model quizzes) to assess whether sycophantic LLM responses reinforce users' pre-existing misconceptions and incorrect beliefs.
Thematic coding of user problem-solving workflows and log events to quantify the frequency of inappropriate over-reliance on incorrect or unhelpful chatbot advice.
